title: Automated Legacy Financial Refactoring
business: Global investment banks maintaining monolithic COBOL-based ledger systems.
problem: The high cost and extreme risk associated with manual refactoring of decades-old, undocumented financial logic during cloud migration projects.
solution: Utilizing GPT-5.3-Codex via the Responses API to perform agentic code analysis and transformation. By leveraging the model's high reasoning effort settings and hosted_shell tool, the agent can iteratively analyze legacy source files, generate unit tests, and propose refactored modules in modern languages while maintaining functional parity.
steps: Ingest legacy source code and documentation into the model context using the 400,000 token window.
Configure the agent with high reasoning effort to map complex business logic dependencies.
Execute iterative refactoring cycles using the hosted_shell tool to validate compilation and logic integrity.
Generate structured outputs for the refactored code blocks to ensure integration with modern CI/CD pipelines.
outcome: A significantly accelerated migration timeline with improved code maintainability and reduced regression risks compared to manual conversion.
limitation: The model may occasionally hallucinate edge-case business rules in highly obfuscated code; verify by checking the output against the original logic using the model's function_calling capability to cross-reference against existing test suites.
